open_items: V5 EAR CHECK (user): S03-B02-SH01, track 77.21-77.66 s: โทษ in ขอโทษนะ, v5 (+3.0 st) against v4 (+1.5 st, store projects/KSO/audio/voice-lock-v4) and v3. Proxy F0 vowel median 178.1 (v3) -> 195.5 (v4) -> 211.0 Hz (v5). Listen for: sharp enough without a squeak at the end of โทษ, and the same narrator.

V5 KNOWN COST of +3.0 st: formants move about +19 % (ratio 1.189). Rising end of the vowel: max 270 Hz in 14.58-14.74 s (below the 330 Hz limit; v4 242 Hz). Spectrum: the source band edge near 13.5 kHz moves up to about 16 kHz inside the word (14-16 kHz band: v3 -26.5 dB, v4 -4.0 dB, v5 +9.6 dB, word window); no narrow tone (8-16 kHz peak-to-median v3 29.3, v5 19.5 dB). Listen for brightness or sizzle on the word against the rest of the track. Fix if heard: a low-pass near 13.5 kHz on the shifted span (a method change; needs the user to ask for it).

V5 PROXY LIMIT: Whisper letters ratio 0.961 (v3 0.982 in the v5 run; v4 0.982). The v3 read in asr-r3.json already scores 0.961 with the same flip (หยุด reads อยู่), so the drop is not from v5. Not a pitch test.
V4 ANSWERED (user, 1 Nov 2026): v4 is "not sharp at all"; the user asked for more pitch on โทษ, so v5 (+3.0 st). v4 stays in the store as the A/B baseline (projects/KSO/audio/voice-lock-v4).

V4 FINDING (Boss/Editor): the narration amplitude is a picture input (mouthAt, duck) and is in the scene cache key (scripts/segments.mjs excludes only narration.src), so any change to the amplitude JSON re-keys every scene. The v4 change differs in 22 frames only; the picture is unchanged where the amplitude is unchanged.

LENGTH (decision needed): v3 track 82.03 s (2461 frames) vs v2 76.60 s (2298): +163 frames = +5.43 s, all in the B06 slot (355 -> 518 frames). The R3 script says about +3 s; the chunk speech measures +5.6 s (Whisper a1 onset to a6 end: v2 10.6 s, v3 16.2 s). Options: (a) accept about 82 s; (b) brisker read (style or pace change, user approval; a new take must pass voice-match, the take1 pace fails the 1.10x gate at 1.13x); (c) text trim (Preaw, script change: the lock re-opens for the changed beats).

EAR CHECK B06 new tail: เพราะใครที่ได้ฟังเรื่องนี้ (9.46-11.08 s of the chunk) and เธอจะไปหาคนนั้น (11.82-13.92 s): the chunk pace is slower than v2 (rate 0.945 x the opening; whispered ขอโทษนะ 1.30 s vs 0.66 s in v2). Listen whether the tail sounds like the same narrator and whether the apology drags.
EAR CHECK join: เธอจะไปหาคนนั้น <whispering> ขอโทษนะ has no written pause (Whisper shows no gap); v2 had the same join (โล่งใจ <whispering> ขอโทษนะ). Decide whether the S03-B02 apology needs a pause.

EAR CHECK B06 head and tail: the chunk head has a quiet murmur (-46 to -52 dB) from 0.00 to 0.36 s; the crop at 0.30 s keeps about 0.06 s of it before the speech onset. The tail keeps a -33 to -40 dB decay to 16.58 s (last word end 16.52 s + 0.06 s). Listen to the ending of ง in ฟัง.

EAR CHECK B06 internal gaps: the written commas (โล่งใจ, เพราะใคร: 0.84 s) carry a quiet murmur at -47 to -53 dB, the same level as the head. Not trimmed (v2 B06 internal gaps were not trimmed either).

EAR CHECK timbre and level: B06 vs the opening (voice-match, v2 B01 span): F0 median 178 vs 181 Hz (-1.5 %), F0 spread 74 vs 68 Hz, centroid 2356 vs 2157 Hz (+9 %, brighter). Level: B06 -16.45 LUFS vs B01 -16.12 LUFS (0.33 LU). The proxy gives a match, the ear decides.
